items.name: Breakfast at Pão do Rei
items.note: On foot from the base. The car stays put.

items.name: PRC29 Caldeiras – Salto do Cabrito loop

parking.name: Caldeiras da Ribeira Grande car park
parking.note: Small lot next to the thermal baths, trailhead board is right there.

items.note: 8.6 km loop, about 3 h. Metal walkways at Salto do Cabrito are slippery when wet.

items.name: Lunch in Ribeira Grande

parking.name: Free parking, Rua da Feira
parking.note: Public lot by the market, short walk to the centre.

items.note: Town centre around the Câmara Municipal.

items.name: Volcanic mud massage, Termas das Caldeiras

parking.name: Caldeiras da Ribeira Grande car park
parking.note: Same lot as this morning's hike.

items.note: Bring swimwear and a dark towel.

items.name: Miradouro da Boca do Inferno

parking.name: Lagoa do Canário car park
parking.note: Roadside lot on the ER 8-1ª at the Lagoa do Canário gate.

items.note: Go early: cloud usually builds on the rim during the morning.

items.name: PR03 Vista do Rei → Sete Cidades

parking.name: Vista do Rei car park
parking.note: Leave the car here; taxi back from the village after lunch.

items.note: 7.5 km one way along the crater rim, ends at the village church.

items.name: Lunch in Sete Cidades
items.note: On foot from the church. Afterwards taxi back up to the car at Vista do Rei (about 10 min).

items.name: Ponta da Ferraria ocean hot spring

parking.name: Ferraria lower car park
parking.note: At the bottom of the steep switchback road. Use low gear.

items.note: Only warm around low tide; check the tide table. Hold the ropes, skip it in heavy swell.

items.name: Miradouro da Ponta do Escalvado

parking.name: Escalvado viewpoint lay-by
parking.note: Park at the viewpoint itself.

items.note: Sunset over Mosteiros.

days.title: Whales, Lagoa do Fogo, on to Furnas

items.name: Whale watching with Futurismo

parking.name: Avenida car park (Portas do Mar)
parking.note: Underground car park on Av. Infante Dom Henrique.

items.note: Check in at Marina Portas do Mar. Luggage stays hidden in the boot.

items.name: Miradouro da Lagoa do Fogo

parking.name: Lagoa do Fogo viewpoint parking
parking.note: Roadside bays on the EN5-2A, fills up around midday.

items.note: Often in cloud. If it is, try Miradouro da Barrosa a little further up.

items.name: Caldeira Velha

parking.name: Caldeira Velha car park
parking.note: Official lot beside the road, below the entrance.

items.note: Timed entry slots.

items.name: Caldeiras das Furnas

parking.name: Rua das Caldeiras parking
parking.note: Lot right next to the village fumaroles.

items.note: Boiling springs in the village. Taste the mineral water taps.

items.name: Fumarolas da Lagoa das Furnas

parking.name: Lagoa das Furnas fumaroles car park
parking.note: Paid entry at the gate (per person), parking inside.

items.note: Cozido pots come out of the ground around 12:00–12:30.

items.name: Lunch in Furnas (cozido)

parking.name: Largo Marquês da Praia parking
parking.note: Central square by the Terra Nostra gate.

items.note: Cozido usually has to be ordered ahead.

items.name: Parque Terra Nostra

parking.name: Largo Marquês da Praia parking
parking.note: Same square as lunch; leave the car.

items.note: Iron-rich water stains swimwear orange. Old dark swimsuit.

items.name: Poça da Dona Beija

parking.name: Dona Beija car park
parking.note: Small lot opposite the entrance on Lomba das Barracas.

items.note: Evening slot, lovely in the rain.

items.name: PRC09 Sanguinho / Salto do Prego

parking.name: Faial da Terra trailhead parking
parking.note: Small lot on Rua do Burguete at the top of the village.

items.note: 4.6 km loop to the waterfall, back via the restored hamlet of Sanguinho. Muddy after rain.

items.name: Miradouro da Ponta do Sossego

parking.name: Ponta do Sossego car park
parking.note: Lot at the garden entrance.

items.note: Gardens, picnic tables, toilets.

items.name: Nordeste + Miradouro da Vista dos Barcos

parking.name: Vista dos Barcos lay-by
parking.note: Roadside bays at the viewpoint. For lunch in Nordeste use the lot on Rua da Nazaré, 600 m north.

items.note: View down to Farol do Arnel. Do not drive down the lighthouse road. Lunch in Nordeste town.

items.name: Cascata do Risco

parking.name: EN 1-1ª lay-by, Achadinha
parking.note: Nearest lay-by. You may be able to park closer.

items.note: Parking and path unconfirmed. Check on arrival.

items.name: Miradouro do Salto da Farinha

parking.name: Salto da Farinha parking
parking.note: Lot at the end of the access road.

items.note: Waterfall view from above; steep path continues down to the bathing area.

items.name: Farolim dos Fenais da Ajuda

parking.name: End of Rua do Moio
parking.note: Roadside, end of the lane.

items.note: Small lighthouse on the cliff edge.

items.name: Chá Gorreana tea factory

parking.name: Gorreana car park
parking.note: In front of the factory.

items.note: Free tasting. Check closing time, it can be 17:00 in winter.

days.title: Lagoa do Fogo shore & Ponta Delgada

items.name: Lagoa do Fogo: walk down to the lake

parking.name: Lagoa do Fogo viewpoint parking
parking.note: Roadside bays on the EN5-2A.

items.note: Steep path down to the shore, about 30 min down and 45 min back up. Skip it in cloud or heavy rain.

items.name: Jardim Botânico António Borges

parking.name: Street parking by the garden
parking.note: Metered street bays around the garden.

items.note: Grottoes and giant fig trees. Free entry.

items.name: Base in Ponta Delgada
items.note: Pack for the flight.

items.name: Refuel near the airport

parking.name: Fuel station on the airport road
parking.note: Any station on the airport road.

items.note: Fill to the level on the rental contract and keep the receipt.

items.name: Return the car at the airport

parking.name: P3 Rent-a-car, Aeroporto João Paulo II
parking.note: Follow the rent-a-car signs. Photograph the car and fuel gauge.

items.name: Flight
items.note: Departs 10:15.
